info.title: cp-core API
info.description: Cleverphotos core API for cp-web. Session cookie + X-CSRFToken. See docs/api.md.

get.description: Sets the csrftoken cookie. Call once on app start; send its value as X-CSRFToken.

post.description:
Sends a sign-in code (dev: to the server log and the admin). `role` defaults to participant.

Errors: 404 event_not_found · 422 invalid_phone_number, invalid_role, validation_error ·
429 rate_limit_exceeded (3 codes per phone per 15 min; 30 s between codes).

Checks the code; signs in, or creates the account. Sets the session cookie. Follow `nextStep`.

Errors: 410 otp_expired · 422 invalid_otp, validation_error · 429 rate_limit_exceeded (5 wrong codes).

get.description: The signed-in user. 401 authentication_required when signed out (use on app start).

patch.description:
Profile: fullName (required), email (optional, null clears).

Errors: 403 csrf_failed · 409 email_already_in_use · 422 validation_error.

post.description:
KVKK explicit consent to the version the screen showed (`user.kvkk.version`); logged with
version, language, file hash, IP and browser.

Errors: 403 csrf_failed · 409 consent_version_outdated (re-fetch /api/me, show the new text) ·
422 explicit_consent_required (granted false), validation_error.

get.description: Events the user has opened, newest activity first.
The user's selfies (slots primary, secondary). Poll after an upload until status leaves processing.

post.description:
multipart/form-data: file (JPEG/PNG/WebP/HEIC, ≤ 50 MB), slot. Replaces the slot's selfie.
Processing is asynchronous: poll GET /api/me/selfies.

Errors: 403 consent_required, csrf_failed · 422 unsupported_file_type, unreadable_image,
file_too_large, invalid_slot, validation_error.

delete.description: Deletes the selfie and its face data. Errors: 404 selfie_not_found.

get.description:
A KVKK document PDF, current or older (what earlier consents refer to). Public.
The current files: `user.kvkk.urls`. Errors: 404 not_found.

head.description:
A KVKK document PDF, current or older (what earlier consents refer to). Public.
The current files: `user.kvkk.urls`. Errors: 404 not_found.

get.description:
The welcome screen: no photos, no counts. With a session, also adds the event to the user's events.

Errors: 404 event_not_found · 410 event_expired · 423 event_access_closed ·
429 rate_limit_exceeded (30 per minute per IP).

Photos of me (`view=mine`, face matching) or all photos (`view=all`, when canBrowseAll).
Ordered by capture time; `cursor` is an offset, `limit` ≤ 500. Always current: re-fetch to see new matches.

Errors: 404 event_not_found · 410 event_expired · 423 event_access_closed · 403 consent_required, browse_all_not_allowed · 422 validation_error (bad view).

One photo with previous/next in the same view, and downloads left today.

Errors: 404 event_not_found · 410 event_expired · 423 event_access_closed · 403 consent_required, browse_all_not_allowed · 404 photo_not_found (not in this view).
Errors: 404 photo_not_found · 429 download_limit_reached (3 per photo per 24 h).
